dots_no_options: Use the poll 🗳️ screen to edit options.
info_feature_edit: Anyone can edit the title, the description, and any option.
info_feature_add: Anyone can add more options with the ➕ button.
info_feature_delete: To delete an option, clear all its text and press 🗑️.
info_feature_vote: Vote for as many options as you like, and change your votes at any time.
info_feature_anon: Turn off [Show my name] to vote anonymously. A 🥷 is shown instead of your name.
info_feature_votes: Turn on [Show votes] to reveal who voted for what and the running tallies. Don't look at the votes before you vote, so they don't sway your judgement.
info_feature_voter_count: ✅ shows how many people voted for at least one option.
info_feature_viewer_count: 👁️ shows how many people have seen the poll.
info_feature_history: Open the history view ⏳ to see every edit and vote change over time.
info_dotvoting_intro: Dot voting is useful for gauging the group's priorities.
info_feature_dotvoting: Spread your 5 dots across the options with ▲ / ▼ to show the group what to prioritise. Turn on [Sort by dots] to rank the options by their totals.
info_dotvoting_options: To add or remove options, use the poll 🗳️ screen.
info_dotvoting_goto: Press 🪙 to vote in dot-voting mode.
info_tip_reread: To read this guide again, press ℹ️.
